text:
Greetings new starters,
Hopeful evening so far, and the welfare lead discussed a reminder about hand-off notes

Welcome to the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways. We keep our hand-offs calm, clear, and kind so every traveler and pet gets steady support. When you pass a case to another team member, please leave a clean note on the service changes, the current status, and any care details that matter for the next step. If a carrier has been moved by the ground team, make sure that is recorded plainly as well, since small updates are easy to miss when the desk gets busy. <<FACT F120>> Keep the wording simple and factual, and avoid adding guesswork or casual shorthand that could confuse someone later.

Please also remember that tone matters in every message, even when the day feels rushed. A reassuring line can help a worried traveler settle, and a careful note can save the next colleague from repeating a check. If you are unsure whether something belongs in the ledger, add it anyway and flag it for review. That is always better than leaving a gap. When you are speaking with a traveler about a pet, stay warm, steady, and practical, and keep the focus on what the desk can do next. If you need support, ask the senior coordinator or the welfare lead before closing the case, because it is fine to slow down and get it right.

Thanks for settling in with care and attention. The desk works best when everyone passes work on neatly and with a calm hand.
